In summary, our research is concerned with
the expression of a monoclonal antibody (mabQ113) in the rat cerebral neocortex.
the characterization of the Q113 epitope and its expression in the rat cerebral cortical layers.
the characterization of the mab Q113 antigen and the development and distribution of its immunoreactivity in various regions of the rat brain.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
mabQ113 is a marker of the Purkinje cell in the cerebellum and a marker of the radial glia in the cerebral cortex.
mabQ113 labels the 120‐kilodaton polypeptide which is a component of the Purkinje cell cytoplasmic domain and which is present only in a subset of adult rat Purkinje cells.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the mabQ213 epitope is a marker of a subset of Purkine cells in the adult cerebellum, and is also expressed by subsets of neurons in the adult brain, as well as by subsets of glia.
the mabQ413 immunoreactive polypeptide is not expressed in the adult rat brain.

The main takeaway from our work is that
mabQ113 is a unique marker for a subset of neurons and glia in all regions of the brain.
the mabQ114 epitope is a useful marker of a subset of cerebellar Purkinje cells, which can be used to study the development and organization of the cerebellum.
in the cerebral cortex the mabQ413 epitope is not confined to a subset of pyramidal neurons but rather is expressed by a wide variety of neurons in all cortical layers.
